method.title: Repository · Agent · Retrieval-Augmented Generation · Code Repository
method.problem: Idea（原文）：仓库级代码 Agent：先用检索增强在整个代码仓库里定位相关文件和调用链，再让 agent 分步修改并跑测试回归，减少跨文件修改时漏改、改错接口的情况。目标是解决撞车报告里的空白点：关键词都被已有工作覆盖了，差异要从问题设定或验证方式上找。
mechanism: 针对 repository 设计专门的模块（样例占位，机制等负责人接手后写）
针对 Agent 设计专门的模块（样例占位，机制等负责人接手后写）
针对 retrieval-augmented generation 设计专门的模块（样例占位，机制等负责人接手后写）
risks: 样例占位内容，机制部分等负责人接手后重写

exp.analysis: 以下是样例占位数字，不是真实实验的结果。3 个种子取平均。Ours 在 3/3 项指标上超过最好的 baseline：Task success rate (%) 58.8 vs 55.7，Average completed subtasks (%) 55.8 vs 54.7，Error recovery rate after perturbations (%) 60.1 vs 58.1。

write.title: Repository · Agent · Retrieval-Augmented Generation · Code Repository
write.abstract: Repository · Agent · Retrieval-Augmented Generation · Code Repository. We target a gap left by prior work. This is a sample draft with placeholder content. Every section is to be rewritten once a lead takes the project over.

sections.related_work: Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation: A Survey with Focus on Repository-Level Approaches~\cite{arxiv251004905} is closely related to our setting. GraphCodeAgent: Dual Graph-Guided LLM Agent for Retrieval-Augmented Repo-Level Code Generation~\cite{arxiv250410046} is closely related to our setting. SpecAgent: A Speculative Retrieval and Forecasting Agent for Code Completion~\cite{arxiv251017925} is closely related to our setting. Other relevant lines of work include TDD-Agent: Test-Driven Reasoning for Code Generation~\cite{arxiv260816742}, MASS-RAG: Multi-Agent Synthesis Retrieval-Augmented Generation~\cite{arxiv260418509}, ProjAgent: Procedural Similarity Retrieval for Repository-Level Code Generation~\cite{arxiv260708691}, GraphSearch: An Agentic Deep Searching Workflow for Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation~\cite{arxiv250922009}, DuetRAG: Collaborative Retrieval-Augmented Generation~\cite{arxiv240513002}.
sections.experiments: We compare against Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation, GraphCodeAgent, SpecAgent on Task success rate (%), Average completed subtasks (%), Error recovery rate after perturbations (%). The numbers in Table~\ref{tab:main} are sample placeholders.
sections.conclusion: This sample draft fixes the structure of the paper; the claims above are placeholders until the method is written and real experiments are run.
